summary: BitFuFu Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release of unaudited Q2 2026 financial results. The report details revenue decline to $42.8 million, net loss of $20.5 million, and reduced hashrate, reflecting market challenges. It includes operational updates and management commentary. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is announced. The filing is a routine periodic earnings report by a foreign private issuer.
